statements: Accounts need a currency and transfers can carry a memo. Ledger database files written by the current version must keep working with the new version, with every account, balance and transfer as it was.

Accounts that exist today are in US dollars (USD) and transfers that exist today have no memo. createAccount takes an optional currency, USD when omitted: three capital letters, anything else is refused with invalid_currency. Accounts show their currency.

transfer takes an optional memo: free text of up to 200 characters, kept exactly as given. A transfer without a memo has memo null. A longer memo, or one that is not text, is refused with invalid_memo. Transfer records show the memo.
Money moves only between accounts of the same currency. Any other transfer is refused with currency_mismatch and changes nothing.
A file written by a newer version than this one is refused with unsupported_schema and left untouched. A brand-new file is created ready for the new features.
transferBatch(transfers) applies a list of transfers all or nothing and returns the transfer records in order. Transfers are applied in the order given.

Each transfer in a batch is checked as a single transfer is and fails with the same error code. The error also carries index: the 0-based position of the offending transfer in the list. When several transfers would fail, the first one in the list is reported.
A batch holds at most 500 transfers. An empty batch is valid and returns an empty list. More than 500 transfers, or anything that is not a list, is refused with invalid_batch and nothing is applied.

Balances stay between 0 and 9007199254740991 cents, single transfers and batches alike: a transfer that would take an account above that is refused with balance_overflow, below zero with insufficient_funds.
Everything that exists today keeps working exactly as it does now.
The README documents the changes, and the new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Extend the ledger library as the numbered ticket statements describe: currency and memo with an in-place upgrade of existing database files, and transferBatch. Document it in the README and add tests under test/. Follow the conventions already in the code and the README. Change only what the ticket needs.
